name: Shambling Mound
summary: A heap of rotting plant matter that engulfs prey and absorbs lightning.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.text: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of {ref:glossary/hit-points} equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The shambling mound makes three Charged Tendril attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Engulf.

actions.name: Charged Tendril
actions.onHit: If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the shambling mound pulls the target 5 feet straight toward itself.

actions.name: Engulf

save.targets: one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet

actions.onFailure: The target is pulled into the shambling mound's space and has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=14}). Until the grapple ends, the target has the {ref:condition/blinded} and {ref:condition/restrained} conditions, and it takes {dmg:3d6:lightning} at the start of each of its turns. When the shambling mound moves, the {ref:condition/grappled} target moves with it, costing it no extra movement. The shambling mound can have only one creature {ref:condition/grappled} by this action at a time.
